={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You extract client registration data from a live, accumulated speech-to-text transcript of a conversation held in Spanish (Peruvian Spanish) at a trade fair.
Two people talk: a SELLER (the NEXAGRO representative) and a CLIENT (the person being registered). Extract ONLY the CLIENT's data. Ignore everything the seller says about themselves or their own company (names, phone numbers, businesses).
Return a single JSON object with exactly these string keys: "fullName", "phone", "industry".
Rules:
- fullName: the client's first and last name as spoken, properly capitalised. Never invent or complete a name that was not said.
- phone: the client's phone number as digits only (keep a leading + if a country code was spoken). Peruvian numbers are 9 digits starting with 9 and are often dictated as separate digits or words ("nueve ocho nueve siete nueve siete nueve siete siete" = 989797977), in groups, or with fillers such as "doble" (double) or "triple". Convert spelled-out digits to numerals. If the digits are incomplete or ambiguous, return what was clearly said, never guess missing digits.
- industry: the client's business sector or line of work, a short noun phrase in Spanish (for example "Agroexportación", "Transporte", "Educación").
- Use an empty string "" for anything not clearly stated. Never invent data. The transcript may be noisy or contain corrections: prefer the latest correction.
Respond with the JSON object only." }, { role: 'user', content: 'Transcript:
' + String($json.body?.transcript ?? '') } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You extract contact data from the transcript of a short spoken self-introduction recorded at a trade fair. The speaker (or the seller recording on their behalf) presents ONE person in Spanish (Peruvian Spanish) and the company they work for. Extract the data of that person and company only.
Return a single JSON object with exactly these string keys: "fullName", "jobTitle", "companyName", "industry", "email", "phone", "website", "instagram", "facebook", "linkedin", "tiktok", "notes", "interestCompany".
Rules:
- Every value is a string. Use an empty string "" for anything not clearly said. NEVER invent, infer or complete data that was not spoken.
- fullName: the person's name, capitalised. jobTitle: their role. companyName: their company. industry: the company's sector or line of business, a short noun phrase in Spanish.
- email: spoken emails use "arroba" (@) and "punto" (.), for example "juan punto perez arroba empresa punto com" becomes "juan.perez@empresa.com". Normalise to a lowercase address without spaces. Spoken letters or digits are joined.
- phone: digits only (keep a leading + if a country code was spoken). Peruvian mobiles are 9 digits starting with 9, often dictated as separate digits or words; convert spelled-out digits to numerals. Never guess missing digits.
- website: domain or URL as said (for example "empresa.com"), lowercase, no spaces.
- instagram, facebook, linkedin, tiktok: the handle (with @ when it is a handle) or URL as said; otherwise "".
- notes: any other useful information said about the person or what they are looking for, as a short Spanish sentence; otherwise "".
- interestCompany: the NEXAGRO-group company the person is interested in, only if explicitly named; otherwise "".
The transcript may contain recognition errors; prefer the latest correction when the speaker corrects themselves.
Respond with the JSON object only." }, { role: 'user', content: 'Transcript:
' + String($json.text ?? '') } ] }) }}
